<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 6, 2026 - Aug 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _ErinV82_, Aug 23, 2026, 1/5: "I canceled my “subscription” on the morning of the last day of my “7 day free trial” and was still subsequently charged for an entire year 10 days after said cancellation."
            2. _mysticalgamer666_, Aug 6, 2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 28, 2026 - Sep 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, May 28, 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _HappyBirdies4_, Sep 1, 2026, 2/5: "Very cute and fun app that allows you to set goals for a variety of life situations and find what motivates you to keep growing or find joy in your life. It helps people, and that means a lot in today’s world. However, this summer has been about serving a younger constituency very clearly. There are two monthly adventures focused on movies for tweens, and the month in between those two was focused on young gamers. They’ve also changed the rewards to limit the colors and selection that you have. Well that might seem like a minor part of the app, those rewards are actually important for neurodivergent people. When it’s a bunch of stuff that has no relevance to my life and doesn’t even give me the option to choose colors that might let it fit into my life or my interests, it’s hard to use the rewards as motivation. And having three of these out of four months this summer or three of three months I don’t remember, which makes it really difficult to keep wanting to use the app when it’s not geared towards a general audience and letting people have the selection that they’ve had before. If you count the wicked month, this has been most of this year that they focused on movies or things for people under age 25. What’s worse is they still have not fixed the glitch that makes the current adventure reload constantly while you’re using the app so you really don’t have a way to opt out of this month’s movie adventure and you can barely use the app for the tools that you need during the day because it keeps asking you to join that adventure and is stuck in a loop."
            3. _lovelyziy_, Aug 30, 2026, 3/5: "Awesome app!!! BUTTT I’m having issues with the monthly quests! So for this recent Queen of Hearts event, i’ve been checking in and getting all my rewards on time but now it’s pushed me back and instead of me being on Day 20 and receiving awards for the 20th, the app has me on Day 18. It’s been like this since i got the app back in November. It pushes me back even when I do everything on time and it’s so unfair, i haven’t been getting all the rewards I should’ve been getting. Please, is there any way to fix this issue on my account and in general? UPDATE: that never got resolved, and now i’m having another problem 😭 I had to delete the app in order to free up storage on my phone for a software update. When I redownloaded Finch, everything seemed fine, except the app had pushed me a day back and took away a reward I had already claimed! Day 25 of August’s Game On! The Gamer Den PC decor. I already had it in color Sweet! My last reward is supposed to be on Day 27. Please, can you put it back on my account? This isn’t the first time this has happened unfortunately."
<!--/ir-theme-->
